name: Roberts' Orchard
description: Roberts' Orchard is an independent apple orchard in 228 Poland Corner Road, ME. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
